That's right. I selected the two cards, hit "Delete," and the warning named both of them by title and told me their saved copies would be permanently removed too — with a clear way to back out beside it. After I confirmed, both were gone and only the card I hadn't picked was left. So bulk delete carries the same real safeguard as deleting one — it spells out exactly what I'm about to lose before doing it, and it's the permanent option, kept clearly distinct from the reversible put-away. That settles bulk delete for me.

That was the last of the batch actions I'd raised. The everyday tidying-up side feels complete now.
